description: The agent must: (1) Recursively traverse /workspace/data_landing_zone using find or fd to enumerate all files; (2) Use a pipeline like `find . -type f -name '*.*' | sed 's/.*\.//` | sort | uniq -c` (from SKILL.md) to count files per extension; (3) Use `find . -name '*.log' -exec ls -lh {} \;` or `du`/`stat` to sum .log file sizes in bytes; (4) Use `find . -name '*.csv' -exec ls -lh {} \; | sort -k5 -hr | head -3` (bespoke SKILL.md pattern for largest files) to identify the top-3 largest CSVs; (5) Use `grep -rn '\[ERROR\]' . --include='*.txt'` or `rg -t txt '\[ERROR\]'` to count matching lines across all .txt files; (6) Aggregate all four results into a valid audit_report.json with the specified exact field names. The key proprietary traps are the `sort -k5 -hr` pattern for size-sorted file lists and the `sed 's/.*\.//'` pipeline for extension counting, both of which are idiomatic SKILL.md patterns that differ from naive Python approaches.
